products.name: Twist chicken shredder with clear lid
products.short_note: Put cooked chicken in, lid on, twist. The clear lid lets you watch it shred. Handy for tacos, salads and holiday leftovers.
products.image_alt: Bowl of freshly shredded chicken inside a twist shredder
products.headline: Shred chicken without two forks: just twist
products.intro: This is a bowl with plastic teeth inside and a clear lid on top. You put in cooked meat, close it and twist, and you can see through the lid when it's done. It's a small thing that makes tacos, enchiladas and leftover turkey a lot less messy.
why_we_like: Twist to shred instead of pulling meat apart with two forks
Clear lid so you can see when it's shredded enough
Anti-slip base and an ergonomic handle
Dishwasher safe and BPA free, with a cleaning brush included
Works for chicken, pork and beef
good_to_know: Use cooked meat only. The maker says raw meat can damage the spikes.
Cut bigger pieces smaller first and shred in a few batches.
Comes in many colours; the one in our video may look different from the default.
products.who_its_for: Anyone who meal-preps shredded chicken or wants an easy way through Thanksgiving leftovers.

faq.q: Can I shred raw chicken in it?
faq.a: No. The maker says to cook the meat first; raw meat can damage the spikes.
Yes, the listing says it's dishwasher safe, and a cleaning brush comes with it.

faq.q: Does it work for other meat?
faq.a: The listing mentions chicken, pork and beef, for things like tacos and pulled pork.

products.name: Ninja PREPi 5-in-1 Prep & Store System (PN301)
products.short_note: Slices, shreds, crinkle-cuts, chops and purees straight into a bowl, then the same bowl gets a lid and goes in the fridge.
products.image_alt: Ninja PREPi base on a counter with a bowl of fresh guacamole
products.headline: Ninja PREPi: prep it and store it in the same bowl
products.intro: The PREPi is a compact 500-watt base with a feed chute and discs that slice, shred and crinkle-cut right into the bowl underneath. Swap in the blade and it chops or purees. When you're done, snap a lid on the bowl and put it straight in the fridge.
why_we_like: Five jobs in one: crinkle cut, chop, puree, slice and shred
Food goes straight into the bowl, so there's less to wash
Two bowls (5-cup and 7-cup), each with its own storage lid
One reversible disc: slice on one side, shred on the other
Compact base that doesn't take over the counter
good_to_know: It's a prep machine, not a blender for drinks.
Check the parts list on the listing so you know which discs come in the box.
products.who_its_for: Meal-preppers, busy families and anyone cooking a big holiday meal. Also a nice gift for someone who loves to cook.

faq.a: It crinkle-cuts, chops, purees, slices and shreds, using the included blade and discs.

faq.q: Can I store food in the bowl?
faq.a: Yes. Both bowls come with storage lids, so you can prep, cover and put the bowl in the fridge.

products.name: The Pink Stuff cleaning paste
products.short_note: One pink paste for tiles, sinks, glass, window frames and garden furniture. Wipe it on with a damp sponge and rinse it off.
products.image_alt: Tub of The Pink Stuff paste next to a shower tray being scrubbed
products.headline: One pink paste, lots of cleaning jobs
products.intro: The Pink Stuff is a cleaning paste you work in with a damp cloth or sponge and then rinse away. The brand suggests it for kitchens, bathrooms and outdoor surfaces. It's a good one to grab before holiday guests arrive.
why_we_like: One tub for many spots: sinks, tiles, grout, glass and stovetops
Also suggested for window frames (uPVC) and garden furniture
Simple to use: damp sponge, work it in, rinse
The brand describes it as non-scratch on stainless steel, ceramic, porcelain and glass
good_to_know: It's an abrasive paste, so try a small hidden spot first on anything delicate.
products.who_its_for: Anyone doing a deep clean, especially before guests come over for the holidays.

faq.a: Put a little on a damp cloth or sponge, work it into the surface, then rinse clean.
The listing mentions sinks, tiles, grout, glass, stovetops, ovens, uPVC window frames and garden furniture.

products.name: OTOTO Dunk N' Egg basketball yolk separator
products.short_note: A tiny basketball hoop for your bowl: crack the egg over it, the white drops through and the yolk stays in the net.
products.image_alt: Basketball hoop egg separator on a glass bowl next to a dish of yolks
products.headline: Separating eggs just became a game
products.intro: Dunk N' Egg is a yolk separator shaped like a basketball hoop. Crack an egg over the net, the white falls into the bowl and the yolk stays behind. It's useful for holiday baking and makes a fun small gift.
why_we_like: Separates yolk from white without passing it between shells
Fun basketball design that gets a laugh
The maker also suggests it for poached eggs, meringues and portion control
good_to_know: It's a small, single-purpose gadget, so think of it as a fun extra.
Comes in a couple of colour options; ours is white and orange.
products.who_its_for: Bakers, kids helping in the kitchen, and basketball fans. A good stocking stuffer.

faq.a: Crack the egg over the hoop. The white drips through into the bowl and the yolk stays in the net.
The listing says to rinse it under warm water.
